# Barmeto Tools Dashboard

> Private, login-gated dashboard hosting Barmeto's Listing Tools (Auto Listing Mapper) and account management. Not publicly indexed.

## Access
- Requires a Barmeto account. Not intended for public search or AI-answer citation — see /robots.txt.

## About
- [Barmeto](https://www.barmeto.com): Barmeto is an SEO & digital marketing agency and ecommerce tools suite based in Surat, India — also offering [PDF Cropper](https://pdfcropper.barmeto.com), [Background Remover](https://bgremover.barmeto.com), and a Link Generator.
